summary.name: Krater
summary.one_liner: Krater is an all-in-one AI workspace offering ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and 500+ other models, plus image, video, voice, coding and an agent, under one subscription.
keywords: connect gmail slack notion github ai
use_cases: switch between chatgpt, claude and gemini in one chat
generate images and video from prompts
automate repeat tasks with scheduled agents
research the web and your own files with sources
generate and debug code with live previews
summary.what_it_does: Krater provides access to 500+ AI models, including ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Grok, and lets users switch models mid-chat. It includes an agent that plans goals, researches, browses the web and runs tools to deliver finished results. It offers image generation with selectable models, aspect ratio and quality, and video generation through models such as Kling, Seedance, Sora and HeyGen. It also supports code generation and debugging with live previews, voice generation and transcription via ElevenLabs and OpenAI voices, and connections to apps like Gmail, Slack, Notion and GitHub. Plans are paid subscriptions with tiered credits, context windows and storage.
notable: One subscription gives access to 500+ AI models and apps
Krater Agent plans goals, browses the web and runs tools
Connects to Gmail, Slack, Notion, GitHub and more
Includes a 44-lesson AI for Beginners course with paid plans
caveats: Paid plans only: Pro billed at $200/year, Ultra at $490/year, Max at $1190/year; Enterprise is custom-priced
Some features such as websites, API access and auto routers are limited to higher tiers
Credits and scheduled task counts vary by plan
